release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.6 fixes paid preflop range availability and stale bitmap handling. A paid-range icon is enabled by an exact 174-catalog match; the 1 BB wallet debit remains atomic and is checked on click. A local bitmap is now accepted only when its size and SHA-256 match the verified source; otherwise the verified embedded image asset is used. The 174 original range images and exact live-state matching are preserved.
